main_text.l: σις[?],hoc est, carminis compositio,& ἀρσις,& θέσις, quæ viua
voce exprimitur. Concurrunt ergo hæc tria in hoc officii
genere: Citharæ sonus, Tibiarum concentus, & viuæ
vocis modulatio, quæ suauissimam reddent laudem Theronis.
Αἰνησιδάμου.[?]) Ἀναφώνησις propositionis, principalis enim
scopus est Theronem laudare, idque ἀρχηγέτας[?].
Ἁ, τὰ Πίσα.[?]) Quinta causa impellens, ipsa Pisa, hoc est, lo-
cus ipse certaminum Olympicorum. at transitum hinc
idoneum venatur ad digressionem de Herculis historia,
& peregrinatione ad Hyperboreos.
Τὰς ἀπὸ.[?]) Commendatio loci ab utilitate. Pisa locus est
à quo ad omnes mortales redundat gloria. Dignus ergo
est vel solus, ut aliquid in eius laudem componam.Obser-
ua vocum metathesin τὰς ἀπὸ, pro ὑπὸ τῆς, (scil.

De Hellanodicis iudicibus.
Ἑλλανοδίκης[?] significat Græcorum iudicem. Varinus vo-
cem hanc interpretatur, inquiens, Ἑλλανοδίκῃ[?] dicuntur ἄρχοντες.

page.notes: Greek passages are read from a small, worn print. Accents and breathings in the commentary lemmata (Αἰνησιδάμου, ἀρχηγέτας, Ἁ τὰ Πίσα, Θεοδώρητοι, ὠ τινι κεχιμένων, ἀνθρώπος, ἀτρεκής, ἀμπελώς, Ὑφοδὲν, βλεφάρων, ἀμφὶ, βάλλω) are doubtful and marked [?]. The first word of the page is a fragment, continued from the previous page. Latin spelling was normalised: u/v and i/j by rule, "auulsum" as avulsum, "Elij" as Elii, "beneficij" and "officij" as beneficii and officii. The printed "componam.Obser-ua" has no space after the full stop, and this is kept as printed. The stray small mark in the left margin at mid-page is not printed text and was left out.
